what_happened.quote: The total business of the bank has reached to Rs.6,37,280 crore, registering a growth of 18.81% year-on-year. In this, the gross advances, the global advances of the bank, have grown by 24.70% year-on-year, reaching to Rs. 2,87,690 crore. And our total deposits have grown by 14.36%, reaching to Rs.3,49,590 crore for the period.
